admin.wizard.title: First Launch Wizard
admin.wizard.signed_out: You are not logged in. Log in with the administrator account created during installation.
admin.wizard.compte.title: Your account
admin.wizard.compte.intro: Shelfhold is new: create the administrator account. It signs you in at once.
admin.wizard.compte.token_help: This is the value of SHELFHOLD_SETUP_TOKEN in your compose file: it proves you are the person who installs. It is neither stored nor shown again.
admin.wizard.compte.no_token: The account cannot be created here yet: no setup secret is set. Add SHELFHOLD_SETUP_TOKEN (at least 24 characters, for example with “openssl rand -hex 24”) to the compose file and restart, or run “shelfhold admin create” on the host machine.
admin.wizard.compte.not_admin: Only the administrator account can configure the instance.
admin.wizard.kavita.title: Connect to Kavita
admin.wizard.kavita.admin_warning: Administrator account required: The key that Shelfhold receives from Kavita acts with the rights of this account. Your identifiers are only used to obtain it: they are neither recorded nor stored.
admin.wizard.kavita.accept: I understand: the key will have the rights of a Kavita administrator.
admin.wizard.kavita.done: Kavita is connected. A dedicated key was created; your credentials were not kept.
admin.wizard.dossier.title: Shared folder
admin.wizard.dossier.explain: Shelfhold and Kavita must read the same folder. Shelfhold drops a small test file there, asks Kavita to read it, then removes it.
admin.wizard.dossier.no_destination: No shelves exist yet: create one, then come back here.
admin.wizard.dossier.no_library: The folder is writable. Kavita has no library on it yet: adopt one or create one, then check again.
admin.wizard.dossier.write_failed: Shelfhold cannot write to the shared folder.
admin.wizard.dossier.kavita_failed: Kavita does not read the shared folder. Add this block to your compose file, then run again:
admin.wizard.dossier.preview_result: {series, plural, one {# series} other {# series}} and {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}: nothing is modified until you confirm.
admin.wizard.dossier.verdict.under_libra: Suwayomi downloads into the library: change its download folder, no file is copied.
admin.wizard.dossier.verdict.outside_lib: Suwayomi downloads outside the library: the adopted files will have to be brought back there before removing the direct mounts.
admin.wizard.dossier.adopted: {count, plural, one {# adopted file} other {# adopted files}}; the library is linked.
admin.wizard.dossier.shelf_title: Create the shelf linked to Kavita
admin.wizard.dossier.shelf_explain: A shelf is a folder of the library, linked to a Kavita library: this is where the first book will arrive.
admin.wizard.dossier.shelf_folder_help: One name, under the shared folder: letters, digits, spaces, dashes.
admin.wizard.dossier.shelf_audit: Before linking the library, Shelfhold asks Kavita which accounts would read it: a shelf limited by age is refused if a child's account can reach it.
admin.wizard.dossier.shelf_create: Create the shelf and link it to Kavita
admin.wizard.dossier.shelf_created: Shelf created and linked to Kavita.
admin.wizard.dossier.no_target: Kavita is not connected yet: connect it first, the shelf links to it.
admin.wizard.kavita.map_help: Optional. Leave empty if you mounted the parent of Kavita's media as shown. Otherwise: folder seen by Shelfhold = folder seen by Kavita, for example /library=/library.
admin.wizard.kavita.map_invalid: Write each pair as local=remote with two absolute paths, separated by commas.
admin.wizard.etageres.title: Shelves
admin.wizard.etageres.explain: Here are the shelves that Shelfhold creates, each with the phrase that says where the files go.
admin.wizard.etageres.advanced_help: The libraries Kavita already had keep their place; the “Family” shelf is limited to age 13. Everything is adjusted later in the settings.
admin.wizard.sources.title: Sources
admin.wizard.sources.explain: A child searches only in the sources marked “family”. Gutenberg and Wikisource, public domain in the United States, are by default; you can decide otherwise.
admin.wizard.fin.title: Finalization
admin.wizard.fin.book_id: Book number on Gutenberg (public domain in the United States)
admin.wizard.sources.name.gutenberg: Gutenberg (public domain in the United States)
admin.wizard.sources.name.standardebooks: Standard Ebooks (public domain in the United States)
admin.wizard.fin.keyring_help: The keychain protects the secrets of Shelfhold. Without it, a backup is useless: export it, encrypted with a passphrase, and store it away from this server.
admin.wizard.fin.recovery_kit_help: The recovery kit is a page to print: it says how to come back, it holds no secret.
admin.wizard.fin.second_admin_help: Optional: a second administrator can take over if you lose your access.
admin.wizard.fin.finish_blocked: To finish: export the keychain and confirm the jurisdiction.

deviceTokens.title: Connect an e-reader
deviceTokens.intro: A device token is an e-reader's password (KOReader): it opens Shelfhold's OPDS catalogue and reading sync for one profile, and nothing else.
deviceTokens.qr_label: QR code of the catalogue address: {url}
deviceTokens.qr_note: The code holds the address only, never the identifier or the secret.
deviceTokens.https_required: HTTPS is required: over plain HTTP the e-reader is refused before anything is checked.
deviceTokens.plain_refused: This page is served over plain HTTP: Shelfhold will refuse the e-reader. Serve it behind HTTPS.
deviceTokens.plain_allowed: Plain HTTP is allowed by the administrator: the secret travels in clear on the network. Keep it to a trusted local network.
deviceTokens.clock_skew: The clock of this device differs from the server's by more than two minutes.
deviceTokens.clock_note: KOReader sends no time: an e-reader whose clock runs ahead (drained battery, no network time) silently ignores newer positions coming from elsewhere. Set the e-reader's clock from the server's.
deviceTokens.method_binary: In KOReader, set the document matching method to “binary” (not “filename”).
deviceTokens.single_server: An e-reader has one sync server: pointed at Shelfhold, files taken elsewhere (for example from Kavita's catalogue) are no longer synchronised.
deviceTokens.in_clear: The secret stays in clear in KOReader's OPDS settings. If the e-reader is lost, revoke its token: it is the only remedy.
deviceTokens.once_note: It will never be shown again. Shelfhold keeps no copy of it.
deviceTokens.as_is: Enter it as it is, with no space or separator, upper and lower case included.
deviceTokens.noted: I have written the secret down
deviceTokens.admin_note: An administrator profile carries no token: the list offers members and children only.
deviceTokens.name: E-reader name (optional)
deviceTokens.error: The token could not be created. Check the chosen profile, then try again.
deviceTokens.forbidden: Children do not manage tokens: ask a parent.
deviceTokens.rotated: New secret for “{name}”: the old one is refused from now on. Type the new one on the e-reader; nothing is paired again.
deviceTokens.removed: “{name}” is removed: its tokens are revoked.
